title: CAN LLMS COOK JAMAICAN COUSCOUS? A STUDY OF CULTURAL NOVELTY IN RECIPE GENERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating culturally adapted cooking recipes generated by LLMs by measuring textual divergence (newness, uniqueness, difference, surprise) against human baselines, and correlating these metrics with established cultural distances (e.g., Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map, linguistic distance, and religious distance).

Analyzing country attribution accuracy in generated recipe titles (evaluating explicit and implicit country mismatches) and measuring ingredient typicality/grounding using TF-IDF cosine similarity to represent specific national culinary identities and regional ingredient preservation.
